1: using System;
2: using System.Collections.Generic;
3: using System.Diagnostics;
4: using System.IO;
5: using System.IO.Compression;
6: using System.Linq;
7: using System.Net.Http;
8: using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
9: using System.Threading;
10: using System.Threading.Tasks;
11: 
12: namespace PZWorkshopDownloader.Services;
13: 
14: public static class SteamCmdService
15: {
16:     public const string AppId = "108600"; // Project Zomboid
17: 
18:     private static readonly string AppDir = Path.Combine(
19:         Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData),
20:         "PZWorkshopDownloader");
21: 
22:     private static readonly string SteamCmdDir = Path.Combine(AppDir, "steamcmd");
23:     private static readonly string SteamCmdExe = Path.Combine(SteamCmdDir, "steamcmd.exe");
24:     private const string SteamCmdZipUrl = "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd.zip";
25: 
26:     private static bool _bootstrapped = false;
27:     private static readonly SemaphoreSlim RunLock = new(1, 1);
28: 
29:     public static string GetContentPath(string workshopId) =>
30:         Path.Combine(SteamCmdDir, "steamapps", "workshop", "content", AppId, workshopId);
31: 
32:     public static async Task EnsureSteamCmdAsync(Action<string> log)
33:     {
34:         if (File.Exists(SteamCmdExe)) return;
35: 
36:         log("SteamCMD not found — downloading it (one-time setup, ~5 MB)...");
37:         Directory.CreateDirectory(SteamCmdDir);
38: 
39:         using var http = new HttpClient();
40:         var data = await http.GetByteArrayAsync(SteamCmdZipUrl);
41:         var zipPath = Path.Combine(SteamCmdDir, "steamcmd.zip");
42:         await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(zipPath, data);
43:         ZipFile.ExtractToDirectory(zipPath, SteamCmdDir, overwriteFiles: true);
44:         File.Delete(zipPath);
45: 
46:         if (!File.Exists(SteamCmdExe))
47:             throw new Exception("SteamCMD download finished but steamcmd.exe was not found.");
48: 
49:         log("SteamCMD ready.");
50:     }
51: 
52:     private static async Task<int> RunSteamCmdAsync(IEnumerable<string> args, Action<string> log)
53:     {
54:         var psi = new ProcessStartInfo
55:         {
56:             FileName = SteamCmdExe,
57:             UseShellExecute = false,
58:             RedirectStandardOutput = true,
59:             RedirectStandardError = true,
60:             CreateNoWindow = true,
61:             WorkingDirectory = SteamCmdDir,
62:         };
63:         foreach (var a in args) psi.ArgumentList.Add(a);
64: 
65:         using var process = new Process { StartInfo = psi, EnableRaisingEvents = true };
66:         process.OutputDataReceived += (_, e) => { if (e.Data != null) log(e.Data); };
67:         process.ErrorDataReceived += (_, e) => { if (e.Data != null) log(e.Data); };
68: 
69:         process.Start();
70:         process.BeginOutputReadLine();
71:         process.BeginErrorReadLine();
72:         await process.WaitForExitAsync();
73:         return process.ExitCode;
74:     }
75: 
76:     /// <summary>
77:     /// SteamCMD self-updates on first run (and sometimes relaunches itself
78:     /// to do so, which can return a nonzero exit code even though
79:     /// everything worked). Running a harmless '+quit' once up front absorbs
80:     /// that self-update so it doesn't interleave with a real download later.
81:     /// </summary>
82:     private static async Task BootstrapAsync(Action<string> log)
83:     {
84:         if (_bootstrapped) return;
85:         log("Preparing SteamCMD (first-time update check)...");
86:         await RunSteamCmdAsync(new[] { "+quit" }, log);
87:         _bootstrapped = true;
88:     }
89: 
90:     /// <summary>
91:     /// Downloads workshopId via SteamCMD, then installs it into destFolder
92:     /// using the layout Project Zomboid actually expects for local mods:
93:     /// destFolder/<workshopId> <ModFolderName>/<mod files directly>
94:     /// (not the raw Steam cache layout, which nests content under
95:     /// content/<id>/mods/<ModFolderName>/).
96:     ///
97:     /// A single workshop item can contain more than one mod folder (some
98:     /// "collection" style items do), so this can install more than one
99:     /// destination folder per item. Returns every folder that was created.
100:     /// </summary>
101:     public static async Task<List<string>> DownloadModAsync(string workshopId, string destFolder, Action<string> log)
102:     {
103:         // Serialize downloads -- SteamCMD does not support concurrent instances well.
104:         await RunLock.WaitAsync();
105:         try
106:         {
107:             await EnsureSteamCmdAsync(log);
108:             await BootstrapAsync(log);
109: 
110:             log($"Downloading workshop item {workshopId} via SteamCMD...");
111:             var args = new[]
112:             {
113:                 "+force_install_dir", SteamCmdDir,
114:                 "+login", "anonymous",
115:                 "+workshop_download_item", AppId, workshopId,
116:                 "+quit",

10: /// <summary>
11: /// One mod's visual + classification data pulled from Steam's public
12: /// GetPublishedFileDetails endpoint: the preview image URL and the tag list.
13: /// WorkshopApiService is intentionally untouched (it stays minimal), so this
14: /// service exists to grab the extra fields (preview_url / tags) the app now
15: /// needs for thumbnails and the tag filter sidebar. Requests are batched
16: /// (up to 100 ids per call) so one request covers all installed mods.
17: /// </summary>
18: public class WorkshopVisual
19: {
20:     public string Id { get; set; } = "";
21:     public string PreviewUrl { get; set; } = "";
22:     public List<string> Tags { get; set; } = new();
23: }
24: 
25: public static class WorkshopVisualService
26: {
27:     private const string Endpoint =
28:         "https://api.steampowered.com/ISteamRemoteStorage/GetPublishedFileDetails/v1/";
29: 
30:     private const int MaxPerRequest = 100;
31: 
32:     private static readonly HttpClient Http = new();
33: 
34:     /// <summary>
35:     /// Fetches preview_url + tags for the given workshop ids in as few API
36:     /// calls as possible. Never throws for an individual item; a hard network
37:     /// failure throws and is caught by the caller.
38:     /// </summary>
39:     public static async Task<Dictionary<string, WorkshopVisual>> GetVisualsAsync(IEnumerable<string> ids)
40:     {
41:         var idList = ids.Where(id => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)).Distinct().ToList();
42:         var result = new Dictionary<string, WorkshopVisual>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
43: 
44:         foreach (var chunk in Chunks(idList, MaxPerRequest))
45:         {
46:             var content = new Dictionary<string, string> { ["itemcount"] = chunk.Count.ToString() };
47:             for (int i = 0; i < chunk.Count; i++)
48:                 content[$"publishedfileids[{i}]"] = chunk[i];
49: 
50:             var resp = await Http.PostAsync(Endpoint, new FormUrlEncodedContent(content));
51:             resp.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
52: 
53:             using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
54:             var list = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("response").GetProperty("publishedfiledetails");
55: 
56:             foreach (var el in list.EnumerateArray())
57:             {
58:                 var id = GetString(el, "publishedfileid");
59:                 if (id == null) continue;
60: 
61:                 var visual = new WorkshopVisual
62:                 {
63:                     Id = id,
64:                     PreviewUrl = GetString(el, "preview_url") ?? "",
65:                 };
66:                 if (el.TryGetProperty("tags", out var tags) && tags.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
67:                 {
68:                     foreach (var t in tags.EnumerateArray())
69:                         if (t.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && t.TryGetProperty("tag", out var tag))
70:                             visual.Tags.Add(tag.ToString());
71:                 }
72:                 result[id] = visual;
73:             }
74:         }
75:         return result;
76:     }

78:     private static IEnumerable<List<string>> Chunks(List<string> list, int size)
79:     {
80:         for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i += size)
81:             yield return list.GetRange(i, Math.Min(size, list.Count - i));
82:     }
83: 
84:     private static string? GetString(JsonElement el, string prop) =>
85:         el.TryGetProperty(prop, out var v) && v.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Null ? v.ToString() : null;
86: }

499:                     var lm = Regex.Match(line.Trim(), @"^id\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
500:                     if (lm.Success)
501:                     {
502:                         id = lm.Groups[1].Value;
503:                         return true;
504:                     }
505:                 }
506:             }
507:         }
508:         catch
509:         {
510:             // Unreadable folder -- treat as unresolvable.
511:         }
512: 
513:         return false;
514:     }

516:     /// <summary>
517:     /// Normalizes a mod identifier for dependency matching: lowercase, remove
518:     /// spaces and punctuation, so "NeatUI_Framework" == "neatui framework" ==
519:     /// "NeatUI Framework" when comparing require= values against installed
520:     /// mods' id=/name= fields.
521:     /// </summary>
522:     private static string NormalizeModIdentifier(string value)
523:     {
524:         var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(value.Length);
525:         foreach (var c in value)
526:         {
527:             if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)) sb.Append(char.ToLowerInvariant(c));
528:         }
529:         return sb.ToString();
530:     }

615:     /// <summary>
616:     /// Scans the mods folder, pulls live details from Steam for each mod,
617:     /// and determines which ones need an update -- this single pass now
618:     /// covers both "list what's installed" and "check for updates" (the
619:     /// tabs used to be separate; merged so there's one source of truth).
620:     /// </summary>
621:     private async Task RefreshDownloadedModsAsync()
622:     {
623:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_settings.ModsFolder) || !Directory.Exists(_settings.ModsFolder))
624:             return;
625: 
626:         AppendLog("Refreshing mod list and checking for updates...");
627:         var records = new List<ModRecord>();
628:         int updatesAvailable = 0;
629: 
630:         // Build an index of every installed mod's declared identifiers (id=/name=
631:         // from its mod.info) -> real workshop id (the numeric folder prefix), plus
632:         // the set of installed workshop ids. This lets require= entries (numeric
633:         // ids or internal names like "\NeatUI_Framework") be resolved purely
634:         // against what is already on disk -- no extra Steam API calls.
635:         var installedWorkshopIds = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
636:         var identifierIndex = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
637:         foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(_settings.ModsFolder))
638:         {
639:             if (!TryExtractWorkshopId(dir, out var knownId)) continue;
640:             installedWorkshopIds.Add(knownId);
641:             foreach (var ident in SteamCmdService.GetModIdentifiers(dir))
642:             {
643:                 var key = NormalizeModIdentifier(ident);
644:                 if (key.Length > 0) identifierIndex.TryAdd(key, knownId);
645:             }
646:         }
647: 
648:         foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(_settings.ModsFolder))
649:         {
650:             if (!TryExtractWorkshopId(dir, out var id)) continue;
651:             var folderName = Path.GetFileName(dir);
652: 
653:             // Resolve require= entries against the installed-mod index above.
654:             var requires = SteamCmdService.GetRequiresFields(dir);
655:             var missingDeps = new List<string>();
656:             foreach (var req in requires)
657:             {
658:                 bool met = long.TryParse(req, out _)
659:                     ? installedWorkshopIds.Contains(req)
660:                     : identifierIndex.TryGetValue(NormalizeModIdentifier(req), out _);
661:                 if (!met) missingDeps.Add(req);
662:             }
663: 
664:             string title = folderName, posted = "", updated = "", steamVer = "Unknown", creator = "";
665:             bool resolvedRemote = false;
666:             try
667:             {
668:                 var details = await WorkshopApiService.GetDetailsAsync(id);
669:                 title = details.Title;
670:                 posted = details.TimeCreated == default ? "" : details.TimeCreated.ToLocalTime().ToString("dd-MMM-yy h:mm:ss tt");
671:                 updated = details.TimeUpdated == default ? "" : details.TimeUpdated.ToLocalTime().ToString("dd-MMM-yy h:mm:ss tt");
672:                 steamVer = string.IsNullOrEmpty(details.ContentManifestId) ? "Unknown" : details.ContentManifestId;
673:                 resolvedRemote = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(details.ContentManifestId);
674:                 creator = details.Creator;
675:             }
676:             catch
677:             {
678:                 // Offline, or the item was removed -- still show the folder by id.
679:             }
680: 
681:             var hasLocalVersion = _settings.LocalModVersions.TryGetValue(id, out var lv) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(lv);
682:             var localVer = hasLocalVersion ? lv! : "Unknown";
683:             var installDate = _settings.InstallDates.TryGetValue(id, out var idate) ? idate : "";
684: 
685:             bool needsUpdate;
686:             if (!resolvedRemote)
687:                 needsUpdate = false; // couldn't reach Steam -- don't false-flag
688:             else if (!hasLocalVersion)
689:                 needsUpdate = true; // never tracked (e.g. placed manually) -- flag so the user can decide
690:             else
691:                 needsUpdate = !string.Equals(lv, steamVer, StringComparison.Ordinal);
692: 
693:             if (needsUpdate) updatesAvailable++;
694: 
695:             records.Add(new ModRecord
696:             {
697:                 Folder = folderName,
698:                 FullPath = dir,
699:                 Id = id,
700:                 ModName = title,
701:                 Size = FormatSize(GetDirectorySize(dir)),
702:                 Posted = posted,
703:                 Updated = updated,
704:                 LocalVersion = localVer,
705:                 SteamVersion = steamVer,
706:                 InstallDate = installDate,
707:                 NeedsUpdate = needsUpdate,
708:                 StatusLabel = needsUpdate ? "Update Available" : "Updated",
709:                 Creator = creator,
710:                 Dependencies = requires,
711:                 MissingDependencies = missingDeps,
712:                 MissingDepsCount = missingDeps.Count,
713:             });
714:         }
715: 
716:         _downloadedMods.Clear();
717:         foreach (var r in records) _downloadedMods.Add(r);
718: 
719:         UpdatesAvailableText.Text = $"Mods with updates available: {updatesAvailable}";
720:         UpdateAllButton.IsEnabled = updatesAvailable > 0;
721:         AppendLog($"Refresh complete: {records.Count} mod(s) installed, {updatesAvailable} update(s) available.");
722: 
723:         // Batch 4: kick off the preview/tag/thumbnail fetch for installed mods
724:         // in the background. Tag sidebar + thumbnails fill in as it completes.
725:         _ = LoadInstalledVisualsAsync();
726:     }

730:     /// <summary>
731:     /// Fetches preview_url + tags for the installed mods in one batched API
732:     /// call, downloads any missing thumbnails into the cache (throttled), then
733:     /// rebuilds the tag sidebar. Runs in the background; grids/tiles update in
734:     /// place because ThumbnailPath raises PropertyChanged.

737:     {
738:         try
739:         {
740:             var mods = _downloadedMods.ToList();

743:             var visuals = await WorkshopVisualService.GetVisualsAsync(mods.Select(m => m.Id));

745:             await Task.WhenAll(mods.Select(async m =>
746:             {

748:                 m.Tags = v.Tags;
749:                 await ThumbnailGate.WaitAsync();
750:                 try
751:                 {
752:                     m.ThumbnailPath = await ThumbnailStore.GetOrDownloadAsync(m.Id, v.PreviewUrl);

758:             }));

760:             await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(RebuildTagSidebar);
761:             AppendLog($"Loaded previews/tags for {mods.Count} installed mod(s).");

763:         catch (Exception ex)

1021:     /// <summary>
1022:     /// Deletes the folder currently on disk for a mod before an update
1023:     /// redownloads it. This matters because SteamCMD's fresh download can
1024:     /// name the mod's folder slightly differently than what's already
1025:     /// installed (renamed subfolder, capitalization change, etc.) -- the
1026:     /// installer only overwrites a folder when the name matches exactly,
1027:     /// so without this step a mismatch leaves the old copy behind and
1028:     /// creates a duplicate instead of replacing it.
1029:     /// </summary>
1030:     private void RemoveOldModFolder(string folderName)
1031:     {
1032:         try
1033:         {
1034:             var path = Path.Combine(_settings.ModsFolder, folderName);
1035:             if (Directory.Exists(path)) Directory.Delete(path, recursive: true);
1036:         }
1037:         catch (Exception ex)
1038:         {
1039:             // Best-effort -- if this fails, the download will still overwrite
1040:             // any folder whose name happens to match exactly.
1041:             AppendLog($"Could not remove old folder \"{folderName}\" before redownload: {ex.Message}", "WARNING");
1042:         }
1043:     }
1044: 
1045:     private void BackupMod(string folderName)
1046:     {
1047:         try
1048:         {
1049:             var src = Path.Combine(_settings.ModsFolder, folderName);
1050:             if (!Directory.Exists(src)) return;
1051:             var backupDir = Path.Combine(_settings.ModsFolder, "_backups", folderName, DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"));
1052:             Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(backupDir)!);
1053:             CopyDirectory(src, backupDir);
1054:         }
1055:         catch
1056:         {
1057:             // Best-effort backup; don't block the update if it fails.
1058:         }
1059:     }
1060: 
1061:     private static void CopyDirectory(string sourceDir, string destDir)
1062:     {
1063:         Directory.CreateDirectory(destDir);
1064:         foreach (var file in Directory.GetFiles(sourceDir))
1065:             File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(destDir, Path.GetFileName(file)), overwrite: true);
1066:         foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(sourceDir))
1067:             CopyDirectory(dir, Path.Combine(destDir, Path.GetFileName(dir)));
1068:     }

<Application x:Class="PZWorkshopDownloader.App"
             xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:sys="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Runtime"
             StartupUri="MainWindow.xaml">
    <Application.Resources>

        <!-- ================= UI font sizes (Settings sliders) ================= -->
        <sys:Double x:Key="UIFontSizeGeneral">12.5</sys:Double>
        <sys:Double x:Key="UIFontSizeButton">12.5</sys:Double>
        <sys:Double x:Key="UIFontSizeTab">13</sys:Double>
        <sys:Double x:Key="UIFontSizeLog">11</sys:Double>

        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="BgDark" Color="#1B2838"/>
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="BgPanel" Color="#171A21"/>
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="BgField" Color="#2A2F35"/>
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="FgText" Color="#C7D5E0"/>
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="AccentBlue" Color="#66C0F4"/>
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="AccentGreen" Color="#5C7E10"/>
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="BorderCol" Color="#3A3F44"/>

        <!-- ================= Button ================= -->
        <Style TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgField}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="12,6"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="3"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeButton}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Border x:Name="Bd" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                CornerRadius="6" SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                              Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}" RecognizesAccessKey="True"/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Trigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard>
                                        <Storyboard>
                                            <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="Bd" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                             To="0.8" Duration="0:0:0.12"/>
                                        </Storyboard>
                                    </BeginStoryboard>
                                </Trigger.EnterActions>
                                <Trigger.ExitActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard>
                                        <Storyboard>
                                            <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="Bd" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                             To="1" Duration="0:0:0.15"/>
                                        </Storyboard>
                                    </BeginStoryboard>
                                </Trigger.ExitActions>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="Opacity" Value="0.62"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                                <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="Opacity" Value="0.4"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <!-- ================= ToggleButton ================= -->
        <Style TargetType="ToggleButton">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgField}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,5"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="3"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="ToggleButton">
                        <Border x:Name="Bd" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                CornerRadius="6" SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                              Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}"/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="Opacity" Value="0.85"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <!-- ================= TextBox ================= -->
        <Style TargetType="TextBox">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgField}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="6,4"/>
            <Setter Property="CaretBrush" Value="White"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="TextBox">
                        <Border x:Name="Bd" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                CornerRadius="5" SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                            <ScrollViewer x:Name="PART_ContentHost" Margin="{TemplateBinding Padding}"/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsFocused" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                                <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="Opacity" Value="0.5"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <!-- ComboBox / ComboBoxItem: colors only. ComboBox's popup template -->
        <!-- is fragile to fully rebuild, so we style it lightly instead. -->
        <Style TargetType="ComboBox">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgField}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="6,4"/>
        </Style>
        <Style TargetType="ComboBoxItem">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgField}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="6,4"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsHighlighted" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"/>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="Black"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- ================= CheckBox ================= -->
        <Style TargetType="CheckBox">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>
        </Style>

        <!-- ================= ProgressBar ================= -->
        <Style TargetType="ProgressBar">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgField}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        </Style>

        <!-- ================= ListBox ================= -->
        <Style TargetType="ListBox">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgField}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
        </Style>

        <!-- ================= TabItem (rounded top, smooth selection color) ================= -->
        <!-- FontSize on the TabItem is inherited by the tab CONTENT, so it must stay on
             UIFontSizeGeneral; the header label itself gets UIFontSizeTab explicitly. -->
        <Style TargetType="TabItem">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="14,8"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeGeneral}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="TabItem">
                        <Border x:Name="Bd" Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"
                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1,1,1,0"
                                CornerRadius="8,8,0,0" Margin="2,4,2,0" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                            <ContentPresenter ContentSource="Header"
                                              TextElement.FontSize="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeTab}"
                                              HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="Black"/>
                                <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Bold"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="False">
                                <Trigger.EnterActions>
                                    <BeginStoryboard>
                                        <Storyboard>
                                            <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="Bd" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                             To="1" Duration="0:0:0.15"/>
                                        </Storyboard>
                                    </BeginStoryboard>
                                </Trigger.EnterActions>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="Bd" Property="Opacity" Value="0.85"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <!-- ================= DataGrid ================= -->
        <Style TargetType="DataGrid">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgDark}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Setter Property="RowBackground" Value="{DynamicResource BgDark}"/>
            <Setter Property="AlternatingRowBackground" Value="#12FFFFFF"/>
            <Setter Property="GridLinesVisibility" Value="Horizontal"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalGridLinesBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="HeadersVisibility" Value="Column"/>
            <Setter Property="AutoGenerateColumns" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="IsReadOnly" Value="True"/>
            <Setter Property="CanUserAddRows" Value="False"/>
            <Setter Property="RowHeight" Value="30"/>
        </Style>

        <Style TargetType="DataGridRow">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1EFFFFFF"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <Style TargetType="DataGridColumnHeader">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,7"/>
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Left"/>
        </Style>

    </Application.Resources>
</Application>

<Window x:Class="PZWorkshopDownloader.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:wv2="clr-namespace:Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Wpf;assembly=Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Wpf"
        Title="Project Zomboid Workshop Downloader"
        Height="880" Width="1300" MinHeight="600" MinWidth="900"
        FontSize="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeGeneral}"
        Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">

    <Window.Resources>

        <!-- Batch 4: shared tile thumbnail block (initial-letter placeholder until
             ThumbnailPath arrives; the image then covers it). Width/Height follow
             the app-wide ModTileSize resource so the slider resizes every tile. -->
        <DataTemplate x:Key="TileThumbnail">
            <Grid Width="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}" Height="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}">
                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="6"
                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="26" FontWeight="Bold"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.45"
                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </Border>
                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="2.5">
                    <Image.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="Image">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Value="">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </Image.Style>
                </Image>
            </Grid>
        </DataTemplate>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="DownloadsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Remove From List" Click="RemoveDownloadEntry_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="InstalledModsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Folder" Click="OpenFolder_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.FullPath, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Page" Click="ModPage_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.Id, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Update This Mod" Click="UpdateSingleMod_Click"
                      IsEnabled="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.NeedsUpdate, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Force Redownload" Click="ForceRedownloadMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Show Dependencies" Click="ShowDeps_Click"
                      IsEnabled="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.HasDependencies, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Uninstall" Click="UninstallMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="UninstalledModsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Reinstall" Click="ReinstallMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Page" Click="ModPage_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.Id, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Forget" Click="ForgetUninstalledMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <!-- ============ Tile mode (Batch 4) ============
             Shared styles so all three tile grids stay consistent.
             NOTE: we pulse via Opacity (DoubleAnimation), never by animating a
             brush Color. WPF freezes SolidColorBrush instances inside shared
             DataTemplates, so ColorAnimation on (Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)
             throws "Cannot animate on an immutable object instance". -->

        <!-- Common chrome for every tile button. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,10,10"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="6"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}"/>
        </Style>

        <!-- Mod name text (Installed tiles turn orange+bold when an update is out). -->
        <Style x:Key="TileNameTextStyle" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
            <Setter Property="TextAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="MaxHeight" Value="34"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,4,0,2"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeGeneral}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Bold"/>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Status line shared appearance. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileStatusTextBase" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="11"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Bold"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#3EB489"/>
        </Style>

        <!-- Update status: solid green, orange + opacity pulse when NeedsUpdate. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileUpdateStatusText" TargetType="TextBlock" BasedOn="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="TileUpdatePulse">
                            <Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                 From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                 Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="TileUpdatePulse"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Requirement status: solid green, orange + opacity pulse when HasMissingDeps. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileRequirementStatusText" TargetType="TextBlock" BasedOn="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasMissingDeps}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="TileRequirementPulse">
                            <Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                 From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                 Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="TileRequirementPulse"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

    </Window.Resources>

    <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            <ColumnDefinition x:Name="QueueColumn" Width="0"/>
        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

        <TabControl x:Name="MainTabs" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"
                    BorderThickness="0" Margin="0">

            <!-- ============ BROWSER TAB ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Browser" x:Name="BrowserTabItem">
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <!-- Address bar -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="8,8,8,4">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Button Grid.Column="0" Content="◀" Click="Back_Click" ToolTip="Back"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="1" Content="▶" Click="Forward_Click" ToolTip="Forward"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="2" Content="⌂" Click="Home_Click" ToolTip="Workshop Home"/>
                        <TextBox x:Name="AddressBar" Grid.Column="3" Margin="6,0,0,0"
                                 VerticalContentAlignment="Center" KeyDown="AddressBar_KeyDown"/>
                    </Grid>

                    <!-- Action buttons -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,0,8,6">
                        <TextBlock Text="Folder:" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="3"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="DestFolderLabel" Text="Not set" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0" MaxWidth="260"
                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                        <Button Content="Download This Mod/Collection" Click="DownloadCurrent_Click" Margin="20,3,3,3"
                                Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                        <Button Content="Add To Queue" Click="AddToQueue_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- Browser -->
                    <wv2:WebView2 x:Name="Browser" Grid.Row="2"
                                  Source="https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=108600&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems"/>
                </Grid>
            </TabItem>

            <!-- ============ DOWNLOADS TAB ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Downloads">
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,8,8,0">
                        <Button Content="Clear Finished" Click="ClearFinishedDownloads_Click"/>
                        <Button Content="Clear All" Click="ClearAllDownloads_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- View toggle + tile size -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,4,8,4">
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="DownloadsListToggle" Content="☰ List" Tag="List"
                                      IsChecked="True" Checked="DownloadsView_Checked" Padding="8,3"/>
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="DownloadsTilesToggle" Content="▦ Tiles" Tag="Tiles"
                                      Checked="DownloadsView_Checked" Padding="8,3" Margin="4,0,0,0"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="Tile size:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="14,0,4,0"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                        <Slider Width="140" Minimum="80" Maximum="260" Value="140"
                                ValueChanged="ModTileSize_Changed" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" TickFrequency="10"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <Grid Grid.Row="2" Margin="8,0,8,8">
                        <DataGrid x:Name="DownloadsGrid">
                            <DataGrid.RowStyle>
                                <Style TargetType="DataGridRow">
                                    <Setter Property="Tag" Value="{Binding}"/>
                                    <Setter Property="ContextMenu" Value="{StaticResource DownloadsRowContextMenu}"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1EFFFFFF"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </DataGrid.RowStyle>
                            <DataGrid.Columns>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="42">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Grid Width="32" Height="32">
                                                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="4"
                                                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.45"
                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                </Border>
                                                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="1.5">
                                                    <Image.Style>
                                                        <Style TargetType="Image">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                            <Style.Triggers>
                                                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Value="">
                                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                </DataTrigger>
                                                            </Style.Triggers>
                                                        </Style>
                                                    </Image.Style>
                                                </Image>
                                            </Grid>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Status" Binding="{Binding Status}" Width="100"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Mod" Binding="{Binding Title}" Width="*"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Detail" Binding="{Binding Detail}" Width="280"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Started" Binding="{Binding StartedAt}" Width="100"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Finished" Binding="{Binding FinishedAt}" Width="100"/>
                            </DataGrid.Columns>
                        </DataGrid>

                        <ScrollViewer Visibility="{Binding Visibility, ElementName=DownloadsTiles}" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                            <ItemsControl x:Name="DownloadsTiles" Visibility="Collapsed" Margin="0,2,0,0">
                                <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                    <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                        <WrapPanel/>
                                    </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Click="ModPage_Click" Tag="{Binding}"
                                                Style="{StaticResource TileButtonStyle}"
                                                ContextMenu="{StaticResource DownloadsRowContextMenu}"
                                                ToolTip="{Binding Title}">
                                            <StackPanel>

                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Button Grid.Column="0" Content="Refresh Mod List" Click="RefreshDownloadedMods_Click"/>
                        <Button x:Name="UpdateAllButton" Grid.Column="1" Content="Update All" Click="UpdateAllButton_Click"
                                IsEnabled="False" Margin="10,3,3,3"
                                Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="2" Content="Export List..." Click="ExportModList_Click" Margin="10,3,3,3"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="3" Content="Import List..." Click="ImportModList_Click"/>

                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,0,10,0"
                                   Text="Mods with updates available: 0"/>

                    <!-- View toggle + tile size + tag sidebar collapse -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,4,8,4">
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="InstalledListToggle" Content="☰ List" Tag="List"
                                      IsChecked="True" Checked="InstalledView_Checked" Padding="8,3"/>
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="InstalledTilesToggle" Content="▦ Tiles" Tag="Tiles"
                                      Checked="InstalledView_Checked" Padding="8,3" Margin="4,0,0,0"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="Tile size:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="14,0,4,0"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                        <Slider Width="140" Minimum="80" Maximum="260" Value="140"
                                ValueChanged="ModTileSize_Changed" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" TickFrequency="10"/>
                        <Button x:Name="TagSidebarToggle" Content="◀" Click="ToggleTagSidebar_Click"
                                Padding="8,3" Margin="14,0,0,0" ToolTip="Toggle tag filter sidebar"/>

                    <!-- Content: tag filter sidebar + list/tiles -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="2" Margin="8,0,8,8">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition x:Name="TagSidebarColumn" Width="190"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                        <!-- Tag filter sidebar -->
                        <Border Grid.Column="0" Margin="0,0,8,0" Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"
                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4"
                                Padding="8">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="Filter by tag"
                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
                                <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                                    <Button Content="Select All" Click="SelectAllTags_Click" Padding="6,2" FontSize="11"/>
                                    <Button Content="Clear" Click="ClearTags_Click" Padding="6,2" FontSize="11" Margin="6,0,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TagCountText" DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="0 tag(s)"
                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" FontSize="11" Margin="0,0,0,4"/>
                                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                                    <StackPanel x:Name="TagFilterPanel"/>
                                </ScrollViewer>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>

                        <DataGrid x:Name="DownloadedModsGrid" Grid.Column="1">
                            <DataGrid.RowStyle>
                                <Style TargetType="DataGridRow">
                                    <Setter Property="Tag" Value="{Binding}"/>
                                    <Setter Property="ContextMenu" Value="{StaticResource InstalledModsRowContextMenu}"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1EFFFFFF"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </DataGrid.RowStyle>
                            <DataGrid.Columns>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="42" SortMemberPath="ModName">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Grid Width="32" Height="32">
                                                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="4"
                                                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.45"
                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                </Border>
                                                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="1.5">
                                                    <Image.Style>
                                                        <Style TargetType="Image">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                            <Style.Triggers>
                                                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Value="">
                                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                </DataTrigger>
                                                            </Style.Triggers>
                                                        </Style>
                                                    </Image.Style>
                                                </Image>
                                            </Grid>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Folder" Binding="{Binding Folder}" Width="2*"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Mod Name" Binding="{Binding ModName}" Width="3*"/>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Status" Width="1.6*" SortMemberPath="StatusLabel">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding StatusLabel}" FontWeight="Bold" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#3EB489"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                                                            <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                                                <BeginStoryboard x:Name="PulseStoryboard">
                                                                    <Storyboard>
                                                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                                                         From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                                                         Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                                                                    </Storyboard>
                                                                </BeginStoryboard>
                                                            </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                                            <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                                                <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="PulseStoryboard"/>
                                                            </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                        </TextBlock>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Requirements" Width="1.6*" SortMemberPath="RequirementLabel">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding RequirementLabel}" FontWeight="Bold" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#3EB489"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasMissingDeps}" Value="True">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                                                            <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                                                <BeginStoryboard x:Name="ReqPulseStoryboard">
                                                                    <Storyboard>
                                                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                                                         From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                                                         Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                                                                    </Storyboard>
                                                                </BeginStoryboard>
                                                            </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                                            <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                                                <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="ReqPulseStoryboard"/>
                                                            </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                        </TextBlock>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Tags" Binding="{Binding TagsLabel}" Width="1.4*"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Size" Binding="{Binding Size}" Width="0.9*"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Install Date" Binding="{Binding InstallDate}" Width="1.2*"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Local Version" Binding="{Binding LocalVersion}" Width="1.1*"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Steam Version" Binding="{Binding SteamVersion}" Width="1.1*"/>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="36">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Content="📁" Tag="{Binding FullPath}" Click="OpenFolder_Click"
                                                ToolTip="Open Mod Folder" Width="30" Height="30" Padding="0"
                                                Margin="0" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                FontSize="15"/>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="36">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Content="🔗" Tag="{Binding Id}" Click="ModPage_Click"
                                                ToolTip="Open Mod Page" Width="30" Height="30" Padding="0"
                                                Margin="0" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                FontSize="15"/>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="36">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Content="⬇" Tag="{Binding}" Click="UpdateSingleMod_Click"
                                                ToolTip="Update This Mod" Width="30" Height="30" Padding="0"
                                                Margin="0" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                FontSize="15"
                                                Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold">
                                            <Button.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="Button">
                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </Button.Style>
                                        </Button>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="36">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Content="🔁" Tag="{Binding}" Click="ForceRedownloadMod_Click"
                                                ToolTip="Force Redownload" Width="30" Height="30" Padding="0"
                                                Margin="0" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                FontSize="15"/>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="36">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Content="🗑" Tag="{Binding}" Click="UninstallMod_Click"

                                                FontSize="15"/>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>

# Project Zomboid Workshop Downloader — Code Analysis

## What the app is

A .NET 8 WPF desktop app (single NuGet dependency: `Microsoft.Web.WebView2`) that finds, downloads, organizes, updates, and manages **Project Zomboid** Steam Workshop mods. It works entirely offline-of-Steam-UI by driving **SteamCMD** (a headless Steam client it bootstraps itself) and Steam's key-less public `GetPublishedFileDetails` API. It ships as a self-contained win-x64 build (`build.bat`).

All app-managed data lives under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PZWorkshopDownloader\`: `settings.json`, `download_history.json`, `uninstalled_mods.json`, `crash.log`, `thumbnails\`, and `steamcmd\` (the game's workshop content cache is `steamcmd\steamapps\workshop\content\108600\<id>\`).

## Project structure

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `App.xaml` / `App.xaml.cs` | Global control styles (buttons, tabs, DataGrid, etc. built on 7 themable brushes + 4 font-size resources); global exception handlers that log to `crash.log` + show a message box and keep the app alive |
| `MainWindow.xaml` / `.cs` | The whole UI hub (~57KB code-behind): 5 tabs, queue panel, log panel, all event handlers |
| `Services/SteamCmdService.cs` | SteamCMD bootstrap, mod download/install, and all `mod.info` parsing |
| `Services/WorkshopApiService.cs` | Key-less `GetPublishedFileDetails` for one item (title, size, dates, creator, `hcontent_file` manifest id) |
| `Services/WorkshopVisualService.cs` | Batched (≤100 ids/request) variant of the same endpoint, extracting extra fields: `preview_url` + `tags` |
| `Services/WorkshopPageService.cs` | HTML-scrapes a mod's Steam page "Required items" section to map name-only deps to real workshop ids (best-effort, browser-like User-Agent) |
| `Services/SettingsService.cs` | Load/save `settings.json` (`AppSettings`) |
| `Services/ThumbnailStore.cs` | Local thumbnail cache (`<id>.jpg`), download-on-miss |
| `Services/DownloadHistoryStore.cs` / `UninstalledModsStore.cs` | JSON persistence (history capped at 300, newest-first) |
| `Models/` | Plain DTOs: `ModRecord`, `QueueItem`, `DownloadTask`, `DownloadHistoryEntry`, `UninstalledModEntry`, `LogEntry` (most implement `INotifyPropertyChanged` so async fills update UI in place) |
| `DepsDialog.xaml` / `.cs` | "Show Dependencies" popup |
| `AboutWindow.xaml` / `.cs` | About dialog (version 1.0.0; GitHub link deliberately disabled) |
| `Models/QueueItem.cs` etc. | (see above) |

The UI is 5 tabs — **Browser, Downloads, Installed Mods, Uninstalled Mods, Settings** — plus two window-level panels: an auto-appearing **Download Queue** side panel and a collapsible **log/status bar** visible from every tab.

## Core mechanics

### Downloading (Browser tab → SteamCMD)
1. The Browser tab embeds a WebView2 pointed at Steam's PZ workshop browse page, with back/forward/home and an address bar (typing non-URL text turns it into a workshop search).
2. "Download This Mod" / "Add To Queue" scrape the workshop id from the page URL (`?...id=N`) and the title from the document title.
3. `SteamCmdService.DownloadModAsync` (MainWindow.xaml.cs:359, SteamCmdService.cs:101):
   - Downloads steamcmd.zip once from Steam's CDN if missing; runs a dummy `+quit` once per session to absorb SteamCMD's self-update relaunch quirk.
   - Runs `+workshop_download_item 108600 <id>` with a global `SemaphoreSlim` lock (SteamCMD can't run concurrent instances); streams every output line to the task's "Detail" cell and the debug log via the dispatcher.
   - Treating a nonzero exit code as benign **if files arrived** (another SteamCMD relaunch quirk).
   - Copies results from the raw cache layout into the user's mods folder as **`<workshopId> <DisplayName>`** — the display name is read from `mod.info`'s `name=` (sanitized), not the raw mod subfolder name. Items with multiple mod folders under `mods/` create multiple installed folders; items with no `mods/` subfolder are installed raw as fallback.
4. After success, the app calls `WorkshopApiService.GetDetailsAsync` once and records the **`hcontent_file` manifest id** in `settings.LocalModVersions` plus an install date. Offline there just keeps the old value.

### Update detection (Installed Mods tab)
- The "Installed Mods" tab is also the updater. `RefreshDownloadedModsAsync` (MainWindow.xaml.cs:621) scans the mods folder, extracts each mod's workshop id from the numeric folder prefix (falling back to scanning `mod.info` files for a numeric `id=`), then queries Steam for live details.
- **Version = content manifest id**, not a date: `needsUpdate` when the local manifest ≠ Steam's manifest, or when a folder was never tracked (placed manually). No match on Steam → not flagged (avoids false alarms offline).
- Per-row **Update**, per-row **Force Redownload**, and **Update All** all funnel into the same path: optional backup → delete old folder (prevents orphaned duplicates when the new download names the folder differently) → redownload → re-record manifest → refresh.

### Dependency handling
- `mod.info` `require=` values are parsed by `GetRequiresFields` (SteamCmdService.cs:220) — each is either a numeric workshop id or a backslash-prefixed internal name (e.g. `\NeatUI_Framework`), split on commas/semicolons.
- Resolution during refresh is **purely local, zero API calls**: an index of every installed mod's `id=`/`name=` identifiers (normalized: lowercase alphanumerics only) → workshop id is built first, then each `require=` is matched against it. Missing deps drive the pulsing orange "N missing" status column.
- The per-row ⚙ **"Show Deps"** popup is the only place the network is used for deps: on explicit click it fetches the mod's Steam page, scraps the "Required items" section (id + title per dep), caches it per session with an in-flight guard, and lists everything with installed/missing flags. If the page has no required-items section it falls back to the local `require=` resolution. Per-dep actions: **Queue** (if a numeric id is known) or **Open page** (falls back to Steam search for name-only deps); **Add All** queues every resolvable missing dep.

### Uninstall / reinstall
- Uninstall (with confirm) deletes the mod folder and appends an entry to the Uninstalled Mods tab (persisted in `uninstalled_mods.json`); **Reinstall** redownloads it through the normal pipeline, **Forget** removes the record.

### Downloads tab
- Every download attempt (including retries) inserts a `DownloadTask` at the top of the grid; the latest SteamCMD line streams into its Detail column. History is persisted across restarts (capped 300), with Clear Finished / Clear All / right-click remove. List ↔ Tiles view toggle with adjustable tile size.

### Mod list import/export
- **Export** writes a `pz_mod_list.xml` (Name, WorkshopID, Author, link per mod). **Import** reads that format and adds missing entries to the download queue (skipping already-installed/queued), so you can replicate a mod list on another machine.

### Visuals: thumbnails, tags, tile views
- After any refresh, `LoadInstalledVisualsAsync` (and equivalents for Downloads/Uninstalled) batch-fetches `preview_url` + `tags` in one call, then downloads missing thumbnails (throttled to 4 concurrent via a semaphore) into the JPEG cache. Thumbs and tags fill in asynchronously via `PropertyChanged` on the model objects.
- The **tag sidebar** on Installed Mods is rebuilt from the union of all tags; checking tags filters the shared collection view (grids and tiles together), with Select All / Clear and a collapsible sidebar.
- All three list tabs (Downloads, Installed, Uninstalled) have List/Tiles toggles; tiles show thumbnail-or-initial-letter placeholders, and status text pulses (opacity animation) for updates available / missing deps.

### Settings, theming, logging
- Settings tab: mods folder picker (one unified folder for downloads + update scanning), three checkboxes (backup before update, auto-refresh on tab switch, debug logging), 10 themes (Light/Dark/Midnight/Forest/Nord/Dracula/Solarized D+L/Gruvbox/Monokai), and 4 live font-size sliders (general/buttons/tabs/log) applied as app-level `DynamicResource` doubles, plus a UI-reset button and the About dialog.
- Themes swap 7 `DynamicResource` brushes (`BgDark`, `BgPanel`, `BgField`, `FgText`, `AccentBlue`, `AccentGreen`, `BorderCol`); `SetBrush` replaces the whole resource since WPF freezes XAML-declared brushes in place.

- App-wide crash handlers append to `crash.log` and show a non-fatal message box on the UI thread; background-thread crashes are reported but terminate (handled by the AppDomain handler's logging only).

`MainWindow` owns everything: it holds the three main `ObservableCollection`s, wires each tab's grid *and* tile view to the same collection (so filters/updates show in both), and orchestrates the services. The flow is: **Browse (WebView2) → extract id → SteamCMD download → copy into `<id> <Name>` folders → record manifest id** for future update checks; **Installed Mods scan** is the single source of truth listing + updating + dependency status; **Services** are stateless-ish helpers; **Models** are INPC DTOs so async data (thumbnails, tags, status) updates the UI without grid rebuilds.

parts.text:
Hold on — I passed `line => AppendLog(line, "INFO")`, but AppendLog's signature is `AppendLog(string message, string level = "INFO")`. Passing "INFO" explicitly is fine. Actually there's an easier way: just pass `AppendLog`. But a method group with optional arguments... `Action<string>` and `AppendLog(string, string = "INFO")` — method group conversion: a method that has an optional parameter can be converted to Action<string> (the optional parameter can be elided). Yes, `line => AppendLog(line)` works, and the AppendLog method group also works. Being explicit is safer. No problem.
